messages:
carla-support: FYI customer reports a huge delta between invoice and dashboard for an embeddings + rerank job run last week. invoice +1,120 units vs UI. they use our async rerank pipeline with pairwise scoring. can someone triage?
ben-ml: can you paste invoice id + a sample request_id or manifest? also did they use pairwise_mode=pairwise or the ranking endpoint?
carla-support: invoice_id INV-2026-04-ACME-9012, request_ids: [r_18f2, r_18f3]. manifest: s3://acme-batch/2026-04-07/manifest.json (shared with customer). they say pipeline is async -> s3 manifest -> our replay job.
eric-billing: initial hypothesis: replay/duplicate processing after a transient failure could cause double counting if idempotency keys not honored in the metering path. any evidence of retries?
ingrid-eng: deploy-bot shows a worker restart around 2026-04-07T02:13Z in the batch-worker ASG. I see two replay runs for that manifest within ~2min in the job logs.
carla-support: customer says they only uploaded once and saw spike on the invoice. they checked dashboard which shows only one run.
ben-ml: odd. dashboard meter and invoice runner use different code paths: dashboard aggregates per-request (filters empty inputs early) while billing/invoice aggregator consumes service-side events from the rerank engine which may include pairwise emissions even for padding/empty rows. can you share a snippet of the manifest and an example input that might be empty/padded?
carla-support: snippet from manifest (redacted):
```
[
  {"id": "row-1", "file": "s3://.../row-1.json"},
  {"id": "row-2", "file": "s3://.../row-2.json"},
  {"id": "row-3", "file": "s3://.../row-3.json"}
]
```
and one of the row-2 JSONs has an empty candidate list (customer said some items are blank strings after CSV parsing).
ben-ml: that could do it. pairwise scoring emits N*M vectors (candidate vs query). If empty candidates were represented as a single empty string token, the rerank engine might still emit pairwise events (counted by billing) while the dashboard pipeline filters those out as length<1.
eric-billing: do we have logs showing the billing event stream for r_18f2?
ingrid-eng: pulled the event log for r_18f2: shows 1,232 "vector.emit" events for that run. dashboard shows 112 non-empty inputs. looks like billing counted the full Cartesian pairs including placeholders.
ben-ml: repro plan: 1) craft a minimal manifest with 1 query + 3 candidates (one candidate = empty string) 2) run async rerank replay 3) compare dashboard vs invoice-meter events. quick curl to trigger replay:```
POST /v1/internal/replay
{ "manifest": "s3://.../test-manifest.json", "request_id": "local-repro-1" }
```
carla-support: can you paste the exact payload you used locally? customer wants to reproduce before we change anything.
ben-ml: sample candidate payload we used:```
{
  "query": "What is the warranty?",
  "candidates": ["2 year warranty", "", "Same as above"]
}
```
ben-ml: results: dashboard reports 2 candidates (it drops the empty string), billing event stream emitted 3 pairwise score events -> billed as 3 vector ops. that matches the customer's invoice delta magnitude (roughly Nextra = number of empty placeholders).
eric-billing: so root cause = mismatch in empty input handling between dashboard aggregation and the rerank scoring path which emits pairwise events even for empty placeholders; plus there were two replay runs due to worker restart which doubled the billed events. combo explains ~2x spike.
finance-billing: can we compute adjustment amount and safe to issue credit? we need exact count from billing events and policy confirmation.
ingrid-eng: quick mitigation: patch batch-splitter to filter zero-length candidates before scoring and add a defensive guard in the metering emitter to ignore pairs where candidate_length==0. I'll open a small PR and canary to 10% immediately.
ben-ml: short-term customer remediation: we can issue a billing credit for the duplicated/replayed portion once engineering confirms the corrected event counts. we'll need idempotency fixes to prevent replays from double-emitting billing events.
carla-support: I told the customer we're investigating, they asked for an ETA on fix and whether they should expect a refund. finance-billing: hold off on public refund promises until we get exact counts.
ingrid-eng: created PR #8342 -> patch: filter-empty-candidates + idempotent-metering-key by (manifest_id + row_id + run_nonce). will canary and post results.
eric-billing: also adding a one-off script to reconcile events for INV-2026-04-ACME-9012: will compute unique (manifest,row,run) tuples and sum pairwise counts, compare with dashboard groupings, produce delta.csv.
carla-support: customer asked for repro steps to validate themselves; ben, can you hand them the curl and small manifest?
ben-ml: shared in DM a test manifest and the curl above. told them: run replay, then fetch /internal/metering/events?request_id=local-repro-1 and compare counts.
carla-support: customer ran the test and confirmed they reproduce the +1 extra pairwise count per empty candidate. they agree to wait for patch. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary for PR #8342 started (10% traffic) — pod set: batch-worker-canary-12a.
ingrid-eng: canary looks clean so far for 15m. no increase in latency and meter emission reduced for tests with empty candidates. rolling to 100% in 30m.
eric-billing: once roll is done I'll run reconcile script and produce a recommended credit value.
finance-billing: please cc me on the reconciliation CSV and estimated refund.
carla-support: closing loop with customer: will follow up with credit estimate + timeline. thanks team. :heart:
